title: 第11章 太极拳第12章 果然他又在搞事情
slug: 不过是穿梭万界为啥都管我叫爹
content_zh:
但随即她就想通了其中的道理：在整个过程中除了主要参与者之外，就是她的帮助力度最大，所以获得奖励也在情理之中。
“加了食盐之后，肉质应该会更好吃了吧。”
童元安露出满意的笑容点点头。
用这种方式提炼出来的食用盐比未来从海洋中晒制的产品要更纯净美味，肯定能把口感提升不止一点点。
此时此刻周围全是期待的目光，童元安不禁苦笑着说：“现在还有谁能吃得进去？”
“额…”
打嗝声接连不断，大伙儿都直摇头，连后土也不例外。
他们一心想着品尝美食，却忘了自己的肚子早已塞得满满当当。
“你们这些孩子真是不知道深浅，别吃太多了，小心撑坏肚皮！”
忽然传来一位巫师严厉的训斥声，在他面前站着几个小孩，挺着圆滚滚的小肚子，手里还紧紧攥着烤肉偷偷往嘴里塞。
几位孩子的家长赶紧把自家的孩子拉到身边教训了起来。
“没事的，等会我教大家一套操练方法，帮助你们消化。
以后再吃多点也不怕难受。”
童元安一说这话，立马让大家兴奋起来。
这一晚狩猎队已经把童元安的拳法传得玄乎其神，谁都知道这肯定是门高深的修炼秘籍。
虽说童元安答应会把这绝学传授给众人，可谁都不敢真当回事。
要知道修炼功法是多么稀有宝贵的东西啊，特别是对于人类来说，一套高深功法足以让整个部落飞黄腾达。
谁会平白无故地分享这样的秘密呢？
但恰恰相反，童元安真的能做到！
而且不加任何条件与限制。

如果一定要找个理由的话，那就只有一个是，真心希望人类能壮大不再被欺负罢了。
没过多久，大家酒足饭饱收拾好了场地。
正当童元安准备教大家打太极拳时，却看到后土转身打算离开。
“瞿柠姑娘不必介意，这只是帮助消化修身养性的一套招数，谁都能来学习。”
童元安明白后土心里在想什么，凭她的正直性格自然觉得应该回避一下，但实际上他说的是真心话。
后世常讲一句话，“民族的就是世界的”
，是整个人类共同的文化遗产，本来他就打算把这套拳术广泛传播出去。
“好吧。”
后土点了点头，既然童元安不在乎她也就不在意了，再说她对这套拳也很感兴趣。
原本空旷无比的广场上此刻站满了人。
在童元安的安排下，所有人都整整齐齐排成方阵，每排之间留有一米间距。
随后，童元安开始正式教授太极操。
起势!
提手!
左挤式!
右挤式!
抱球势!
琵琶掌!
……
童元安先示范了一遍给所有人看，引来阵阵赞叹。

看着动作流畅优美，似乎并不难的样子，但这真的不是修行功法吗？而是一种有助于消化的运动而已？
不过随着训练的深入，大家逐渐意识到原来这套路看起来容易学起来难得很。
这绝对是一门高级的修炼功法！
所有人都精神抖擞、目不转睛地看着童元安，生怕错过一点关键之处或者某个细节动作。
content_en:
But then she figured out the reason: apart from the main participants, she was the most helpful in the whole process, so it was reasonable to receive a reward.
"After adding salt, the meat should taste better."
Tong Yuanan nodded with a satisfied smile.
The edible salt extracted in this way is purer and more delicious than the products dried from the ocean in the future, and it will definitely improve the taste by more than a little.
At this moment, the people around him were all looking expectantly. Tong Yuanan couldn't help but smile bitterly and said, "Who else can eat it now?"
"Um..."
Hiccups continued one after another, and everyone shook their heads, even Houtu.
They were so focused on tasting delicious food that they forgot that their stomachs were already full.
"You kids really don't know what's going on. Don't eat too much, or you'll burst your belly!"
Suddenly, there was a stern reprimand from a wizard. In front of him stood several children, with round bellies, holding barbecued meats tightly in their hands and secretly stuffing them into their mouths.
Several parents of their children quickly pulled their children over to teach them a lesson.
"It's okay. I will teach you a set of training methods later to help you digest.
You won’t feel uncomfortable if you eat more in the future. "
As soon as Tong Yuanan said this, everyone immediately became excited.
That night, the hunting team had taught Tong Yuanan's boxing skills to a level that was astonishing. Everyone knew that this must be a profound training secret.
Although Tong Yuanan promised to teach this secret skill to everyone, no one dared to take it seriously.
You must know how rare and precious the cultivation of skills is, especially for humans. A set of advanced skills is enough to make the entire tribe prosperous.
Who would share such a secret without any reason?
But on the contrary, Tong Yuanan can really do it!
And without any conditions or restrictions.
If I have to find a reason, there is only one reason: I sincerely hope that human beings can grow stronger and no longer be bullied.
It didn’t take long for everyone to have a good time and tidy up the venue.
Just when Tong Yuanan was about to teach everyone Tai Chi, he saw Hou Tu turning around and preparing to leave.
"Don't mind, Miss Qu Ning. This is just a set of tricks to help with digestion and self-cultivation. Anyone can learn it."
Tong Yuanan understood what Hou Tu was thinking. With her upright character, she naturally felt that she should avoid it, but in fact, he was telling the truth.
Later generations often say, "What belongs to the nation belongs to the world."
, is the common cultural heritage of all mankind. Originally, he planned to spread this boxing skill widely.
"Okay."
Hou Tu nodded. Since Tong Yuanan didn't care about her, she didn't care. Besides, she was also very interested in this boxing set.
The originally empty square was now filled with people.
Under Tong Yuanan's arrangement, everyone lined up neatly in a square formation, leaving a one-meter gap between each row.
Later, Tong Yuanan began to formally teach Tai Chi.
Get going!
Handle!
Left squeeze!
Right squeeze!
Hold the ball!
Pipa Palm!
…
Tong Yuanan first demonstrated it to everyone, which attracted bursts of admiration.
Looking at the smooth and graceful movements, it seems that it is not difficult, but is this really not a cultivation method? Is it just an exercise that helps digestion?
However, as the training progressed, everyone gradually realized that this routine seemed easy to learn but was very difficult to learn.
This is definitely an advanced cultivation technique!
Everyone was full of energy and looked at Tong Yuanan intently, for fear of missing some key point or some detailed action.
